newsitem.title: USA: Pechiney unit loses patent lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney unit loses patent lawsuit.

text.p: Pechiney SA said Monday it expects its 1996 results to reflect a $102 million judgment issued against its subsidiary, American National Can Co, in a patent infringement case.

The company said the $102 million in damages could be increased by as much as three times since the jury deemed the infringement to be willful. The lawsuit, filed in U.S. District Court in Chicago, involved patents on plastic film for shrink-bag packaging of meat and poultry products.
Pechiney said American Can intends to pursue remedies to have the verdict set aside or reduced.
The company said it will have no further comment until the final judgment is issued.
